Anna L: Quick standup — I checked the Console per-route KPI tiles this morning. Token-level latency is pretty noisy for two high-qps routes. We need p50/p95/p99, throughput, and error rate panels, plus a clear attribution panel that breaks out kernel selection vs KV cache warmup vs batching.

Mike R: +1. Can you paste the PromQL or whatever we used for token-level slices? The dashboard is showing weird spikes at ~200ms that don't match infra events.

Anna L: Here's the core query we shipped (simplified):
```
token_latency_seconds_bucket{route=~"/chat-.*"} 
# then histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(...[5m])) by (le, route))
```
Those spikes line up to elevated kernel_variant="fallback" traces for some requests.

Devon K: I dug into traces — we see a short-lived kernel handoff when the slow path kernel is chosen (rare). The batching heuristics also force single-request batches for some token shapes. Suggest we add a tag: kernel_variant and batch_size to telemetry spans.

Jia W: Agree. Also the KV warmup ratio is missing from the route card. Can we add a derived metric: kv_warmup_ratio = kv_prefetch_hits / total_requests (5m avg)? That will help tell warmup vs kernel issues.

Sam O: For the dashboard layout:
- Top row: p50/p95/p99 lines (per-route), small toggle for sequence-length bucket.
- Mid row: token-level waterfall (stacked bars: queuing + kernel exec + kv-lookup + encode).
- Bottom: throughput heatmap + error rate + kernel_variant distribution pie.

Mike R: Waterfall panel sounds good. To implement waterfall we need per-token timing fields from the runtime:
```
token_timing{phase="queue",route="/chat-x"} 0.003
token_timing{phase="kernel_exec",route="/chat-x"} 0.045
```
If that's too much cardinality we can use sampling: emit full breakdown for 1% of tokens and aggregate.

Anna L: Sampling is fine for initial rollout. But we should surface raw sample counts so users understand noise. Add sample_count to card.

Devon K: Action items I can take: add kernel_variant + batch_size + sample_count to spans/metrics, wire kv_warmup_ratio, and add a TTL-limited sample sink for detailed token breakdowns.

Jia W: I'll update the Console panel spec: include SLO overlay lines and a small note about sample error when sample_count < 100. Will link to the perf playbook.

Sam O: One more ask — include a quick toggle to attribute slow p99 to a single cause (kernel vs kv vs batching) using a rule engine: if kernel_exec_p99 > 50% of total -> label kernel. Else if kv_warmup_ratio > 20% -> label kv-warmup. Simple heuristics to start.

Anna L: Love it. @deploy-bot can you post the telemetry rollout PR link when it's merged?

deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: telemetry/2385-add-token-breakdown -> staging at 2026-03-18T15:30Z :rocket:

Mike R: Post-deploy, let's run a 24h comparison view (old vs new metrics) to validate there are no regressions or new cardinality spikes.

Anna L: OK — I'll create the compare dashboard and assign follow-ups. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
